text: CH08: prop:c8-Tsafe: the proof says 'the two adjacent edges decay as |y|^{-3} each (one derivative, Proposition prop:c3-P)'. This is false for the A x A component of P, which has no derivative and decays as |y|^{-2}. An insertion of S^(1)(Delta) between an A x A edge and a c x A*|_V edge is of order |y|^{-4} at leading order and converges only because that leading term is odd in y. In addition, the composite kernel (P*)^2 decays only as |x-y|^{-1}, and its Q-primitive is IR-log divergent at T = infinity. Evidence: delta_theory prop:d-psi (iv), prop:d-T; toy small-momentum table in delta_toy_results.json. Proposed fix: replace that sentence with 'the adjacent edges decay as |y|^{-3} (components c x A*|_V, lambda x lambda) or |y|^{-2} (component A x A); for Delta and so(V), whose vector fields act as Euler and rotation operators preserving homogeneity, the leading term of an insertion between an A x A and a c x A*|_V edge is of order |y|^{-4} and odd in y, so the graph sums converge after the angular integration at fixed |y|, the cutoff e^{-|y|^2/4T} being rotation invariant; the composite line P* v. P* has kernel of order |x-y|^{-1} and is treated in Step 2.'
